verdict.rationale: The Agent Toolkit says it gives agents pre-built functions to "access orders… shipment tracking" through MCP and agent frameworks, and runtime probes confirm the SDK and MCP server are live. However, that surface is merchant-oriented. The named tools cover creating orders and shipments (create_order, pay_order, create_shipment), not reading back status, and the agentic checkout paths (Store Sync, ACP, UCP) hand orders to the merchant's own order system without any documented way for the buying agent to query order status. missing for 10: an explicitly documented order-status or tracking read tool (e.g. get_order or get_tracking), a post-purchase status endpoint for the buying agent in the Store Sync/ACP/UCP flows, hands-on corroboration.
